notes.title: Goblins will become Free to Play!
notes.content:
Hark! 'Tis with great merriment that I doth announce: "Goblins shalt anon becometh [b]Free to Play![/b]" Pray, let the trumpets sound and the bells ring! I doth extend my heartfelt gratitude to all ye noble players who hath journeyed alongside me.

I had a lot of fun making this game and a huge shoutout to all the players who supported me by purchasing it. However, after some careful consideration of its current play time the last 6 months and the fact that I would love more people to play it, I have decided to make it "Free to Play" indefinitely.  

[b]Multiplayer Moving Forward:[/b] There will be a lot of new players and I am sure the multiplayer will break more often as well. Unfortunately, since I am moving on from this project I will [b]not[/b] be making future updates or patches. I was and am able to play many matches with my friends successfully and enjoy them. Ultimately, the multiplayer is largely unfinished but still very functional. 




Best Regards, 
NeonWizardGames

notes.title: Update v1.10 - New UI
notes.content:
As Goblins prepares to head into Multiplayer content, it has received a necessary UI expansion. This new UI is of a more modern style and hopefully just as simple for players to navigate. 

The UI will continue to receive regular changes in bug fix updates; you will most likely not be notified of these changes unless they impact gameplay. All further UI design will be modular in structure, compared to the hard coded/stylized previous version.

notes.title: UPDATE V_1.3 (patch notes)
notes.content:
[b]After gameplay testing, the delay/recharge time after spawning a TROOP in battle will be removed.[/b] 
Players will no longer have to wait a set amount of time to buy another TROOP. This change will also require the player to make smarter and more timed decisions when attacking. 

[i]Changed gameplay mechanic: 
-set all TROOP recharge times to 0.5 sec[/i]



[b]This update also contains some preliminary files for the NEW mini-game that will be released soon.[/b]
This content update will allow players more interaction, as well as let the player to take breaks from BATTLES and have another option for fun within the game.

notes.title: Goblins is Finally Getting Released!
notes.content:
[b]After months of development, Goblins is finally getting released this week! (March 17th).[/b]

Players will be able to unlock all 10 Unique Troops, Artillery and battle through 20 Unique Maps in Campaign and Freeplay.  

While the game will be released at this time, the development process has not quite finished. This game will be technically be a LIVE BUILD and in the coming weeks and months players can expect massive updates including but not limited to: Steam Multiplayer, Bonus Mini-Games, Troop Cosmetics.

Thank you for playing!
